source_provisions.role: lamp visibility and mounting measurement conditions
source_provisions.measurement_needed: Unloaded straight level unlighted highway under normal atmosphere for stated lamp-distance tests; unloaded-ground lamp-center height.
At least two front headlamps, one on each side; independently measured mounting height within 24 to 54 inches.
Two rear red tail lamps unless applicable historic exception; 500-foot rear visibility, mounting and spacing, legible illuminated plate at 50 feet, and wiring with headlamps.
Lighted qualifying headlamp display during 484D.100 trigger unless parked; any front auxiliary or spot lamp intensity and total count.
If parked, independently establish 1,000-foot light and roadway/shoulder status, 500-foot front/rear lamp visibility and side placement, and dimming of any displayed headlamp.
